mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate at or below 0.1% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in sustained monetary accommodation.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is at or below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 7.5% signals a weak labor market, which typically leads to continued monetary stimulus and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market anticipates policy support.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE is above 7.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1400 thousand units signals weakening consumer demand, which triggers policy support and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in stimulus.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST is below 1400.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 (index, 2017=100) signals a contraction in the real economy, which triggers policy support and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market anticipates stimulus.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO is below 100.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of near-zero interest rates (FEDFUNDS <= 0.1%) and high unemployment (UNRATE >= 7.5%) signals a severe economic downturn requiring aggressive policy support, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when both FEDFUNDS <= 0.1 and UNRATE >= 7.5.

mechanism_narrative: During the post-recession recovery phase (indicated by INDPRO above 100), improving industrial production signals strengthening supply conditions and economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods classified as post-recession recovery (INDPRO > 100).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales below 530,000 million dollars signals weakening consumer demand, which triggers policy support and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market anticipates stimulus.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when RSAFS is below 530000.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in payroll employment below 140,000 thousand signals a deteriorating labor market, which triggers policy support and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as the market prices in immediate stimulus.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS is below 140000.
